function declaredString(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
const declaredMixed: (string | number)[] = ['a', 2, 'b'];
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(declaredString).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
for (const value of declaredMixed) {
  if (declaredString(value)) console.log(value.toUpperCase());
  else console.log(value.toFixed(1));
}
class DeclaredGuards {
  number(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'number'; }
  static string(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
}
const declaredGuards = new DeclaredGuards();
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(declaredGuards.number).map(value => value.toFixed(1)));
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(DeclaredGuards.string).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
const declaredObjectGuard = { string(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; } };
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(declaredObjectGuard.string).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
function declaredNonNull<T>(value: T) { return value !== null && value !== undefined; }
const declaredNullable: (string | null | undefined)[] = ['c', null, undefined];
console.log(declaredNullable.filter(declaredNonNull).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
function declaredNested(value: unknown) {
  function unrelated() { return false; }
  return typeof value === 'string';
}
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(declaredNested).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
function declaredExplicit(value: unknown): value is string;
function declaredExplicit(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
console.log(declaredMixed.filter(declaredExplicit).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
let declaredOuter: unknown = 'outer';
if (declaredString(declaredOuter)) console.log(declaredOuter.toUpperCase());
declaredOuter = 3;
if (declaredGuards.number(declaredOuter)) console.log(declaredOuter.toFixed(2));
function declaredExplicitNonNull<T>(value: T): value is NonNullable<T> { return value !== null && value !== undefined; }
console.log(declaredNullable.filter(declaredExplicitNonNull).map(value => value.toUpperCase()));
function nonPredicateIdentity<T extends number>(value: T) { return value; }
console.log([1, 2].map(nonPredicateIdentity).map(value => value.toFixed(1)));
class ComposedDeclaredGuards {
  string(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
  composed(value: unknown) { return this.string(value); }
}
const composedDeclaredGuards = new ComposedDeclaredGuards();
for (const value of declaredMixed) {
  if (composedDeclaredGuards.composed(value)) console.log('composed', value.toUpperCase());
}
function nonNullableBranch<T>(value: T & {}) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) { const unreachable: never = value; return unreachable; }
  return value;
}
console.log(nonNullableBranch('present'));
